## Screen recording

Every UI change, feature, or bug fix needs a short recording (15 to 60 seconds) that reviewers can watch inline, or a framed screenshot for a static screen. Fixes and UI changes get a before/after clip; a new feature gets one demo clip. If before and after look the same, skip the video and say so here. Make it only with [tools/pr-recording](../tools/pr-recording/README.md): `capture.sh`, `compose.sh`, `post.sh`. Never commit the video file.

<!-- Run post.sh once per comparison, then link the comments here. -->
